news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff. It is homecoming at Florida.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh apologizes to his coach
news.summary: The Florida running back sent coach Jon Sumrall a text message Sunday to say he was sorry for how he played in the 45-17 loss at Missouri. Baugh carried the ball 12 times for 13 yards in that game.

news.headline: Sumrall says the Gators will regroup
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall told reporters Monday that he hates losing more than he likes winning, and that the team has to recalibrate and keep moving forward. Running back Jadan Baugh got only 13 yards on 12 carries at Missouri.

news.headline: Florida falls to No. 16 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Gators dropped eight spots in the Associated Press poll on Sunday after losing at Missouri. Missouri is now ranked 14th, two spots ahead of Florida.

nextGame.note: The Red River game against Oklahoma, played in Dallas.

news.headline: Texas is healthier after its week off
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Monday the Longhorns are healthier than they were a week ago. Texas did not play last weekend and meets Oklahoma in Dallas on Saturday.

news.headline: Arch Manning turns up at a middle school game
news.summary: With Texas off this week, Manning went to a middle school football game in Austin on Monday night and spent time with the players. Texas is 4-0 and plays Oklahoma in Dallas on October 10.

news.headline: Texas stays No. 1 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Longhorns kept the top spot in the Associated Press poll after winning 20-17 at Tennessee. They are 4-0 and play Oklahoma in Dallas on October 10.

nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in the Superdome.

news.headline: Saints do not know yet if Kaden Elliss can play
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Tuesday he will have to wait and see whether the linebacker can practice this week. Elliss has a hurt calf and missed Monday night's loss, when Atlanta ran for 205 yards.

news.headline: Atlanta beats the Saints 45-24
news.summary: Atlanta ran for 205 yards and five touchdowns Monday night in the Superdome, and the Saints never got closer than seven points. Alvin Kamara ran for two short touchdowns, and New Orleans is now 1-3.

news.headline: Tyler Shough hurt his hand in the loss
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said the quarterback's hand swelled up after he was hit Monday night, but he does not think it changed the way Shough played. Moore called it a really disappointing game and said the Saints did not do enough in any part of it.

tv.name: PSAC Sports Digital Network
tv.note: Every IUP volleyball game is on the PSAC Sports Digital Network, and it is free. The app is on Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, iPhone and Android, or tap right here on game day. Edinboro is the home team, so this match plays on their channel.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP loses in five sets and its streak ends
news.summary: Pitt-Johnstown won the fifth set 15-11 on Saturday in Johnstown to take the match 3-2. It is IUP's first loss since August, after 11 wins in a row, and the Crimson Hawks are now 12-4.

news.headline: IUP sweeps California for its 11th win in a row
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-18, 25-20, 25-23 at home on Friday. Jessica Neiman had 14 kills and Delaney Concannon had 13 kills and 14 digs, and IUP is 12-3 and still unbeaten in the conference.

nextGame.note: Game 3, back home in New York. Tampa Bay leads the series two games to none, so the Yankees have to win Wednesday night to keep playing. Max Fried pitches for New York.

news.headline: Max Fried pitches Game 3 on Wednesday night
news.summary: Manager Aaron Boone is giving Fried the ball Wednesday night at Yankee Stadium with the Yankees down two games to none. Nick Martinez pitches for Tampa Bay, and a loss ends New York's season.

news.headline: Tampa Bay beats the Yankees 5-2
news.summary: The Yankees made four errors Monday night in St. Petersburg and Tampa Bay scored four runs in the fifth inning. Ben Rice hit two home runs for New York, which now has to win three games in a row to stay alive.

news.headline: Spencer Jones hits a fly ball off the catwalk
news.summary: The Yankees rookie hit a towering fly ball in the second inning Monday night that struck one of the catwalks hanging over the field at Tropicana Field. It came down in right field, and Victor Mesa Jr. caught it for an out.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins its first game, 50-0
news.summary: The Eagles shut out Riverdale 50-0 on Thursday in Jefferson for their first win of the year. Warren Easton is now 1-4.

news.headline: Warren Easton loses at Zachary
news.summary: Zachary won 49-28 on Friday night. Warren Easton is 0-4 and plays at Riverdale on Thursday, October 1.

news.headline: Warren Easton falls to Brother Martin
news.summary: Brother Martin scored early and often Friday night and won 56-6. Warren Easton is 0-3 and plays at Zachary next Friday.
